title: Route story map (9:16)
description: A 16-second vertical journey map on real coastlines (Natural Earth, public domain): the title rises, the map settles on the route, then for each leg the camera eases to frame it while a marker draws the route, a ripple and a stop card fire on arrival, and distance and duration counters count up to the totals stated in the brief. It ends on the whole labelled route. Three to five stops placed from latitude and longitude. Code-rendered (scene.route-map), so it needs no footage, maps service or downloads.

copy_examples.brief: Island-hopping recap for our travel account: Piraeus (37.94, 23.64), Mykonos (37.45, 25.33) and Santorini (36.42, 25.43), 9 days in all. Card notes: Ferry from Athens, Two days of beaches, Sunset in Oia. Voyage look.
copy_examples.note: Places, coordinates, notes and the duration are copied exactly from the brief; no distance is stated, so it is left out and the distance counter is hidden. The title names the trip without adding claims.

style.typography: Inter ExtraBold title and stop names, tracked caps counter labels

direction.action: Map settles on the route; per leg the camera frames it, the marker draws it, a card lands on arrival; pull back to the whole route

notes: The animation is code (recipes/scene/route-map) on Natural Earth 1:50m land and boundaries (public domain); the content model supplies only the title, stop names, coordinates, optional notes and totals, all copied verbatim from the brief except the title.

Stops 4 and 5 are optional; a named stop whose coordinates are left at 0, 0 fails the render instead of being placed in the Gulf of Guinea. Legs are stylised arcs or rhumb lines, never real roads or rails.
Distance and duration are shown exactly as stated; legs share them in proportion to great-circle length while the counters run. The recipe never computes a distance of its own.
Copy is fitted with measured glyphs (title 40, stop 20, note 28 characters); the render fails rather than overflowing.

Sound is cued to beats that do not depend on the number of stops: the opening zoom (frame 0), the first card (frame 23, 0.77 s), the pull-back (frame 396, 13.2 s) and a swell under the final overview. Arrival times vary with the stop count, so arrivals carry no fixed cue.

quality_gates.description: Integrated loudness lands within 1 LU of the -14 LUFS delivery target.
Decoded true peak stays at or below -0.5 dBTP after AAC encoding.
No stretch of blank picture (no visible contrast, any colour) lasts longer than 0.5 seconds.
A reviewer checks every place name, coordinate, distance and duration against the source, and confirms the Natural Earth borders shown are acceptable for the audience.
